description: Bounded coverage-guided Rust core checks. Generated command stimuli do not independently establish all command semantics. Existence is separate from actual execution, sanitizer failures and native acceptance.

cases.expected: Rejected raw and checksum-repaired document inputs preserve bytes and revision; accepted imports produce canonical round-trips and finite geometry.
Rejected typed operations preserve the projection, committed bytes and live geometry; committed snapshots remain decodable and finite across bounded command sequences.
